title: Eleven Attempts, One Cairn
subtitle: 山川山地 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 山川山地（自然生态·山川与地形）
meta: 主题语境：山川山地（自然生态·山川与地形）　|　核心词汇：top　|　正文 350 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 top 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: My uncle climbed the same mountain eleven times and reached the ① top once, and the top was in cloud every time but that one. He said the other ten were not failures, which my father said was a way of talking and not a way of counting. The mountain is not high — eleven hundred metres — and at the ② top of it there is a cairn with a tin inside, and everybody who gets up puts something in the tin.

He was never a ③ top climber, by which I mean he was slow and frightened, and the people who climb with rope and iron are neither. His ④ top was always too thin for the height, a shirt in October and the same shirt in March, and my mother put a jersey in his bag every time and he took it out again at the car.

⑤ On top of all that, he knew the mountain ⑥ from top to bottom, having walked every side of it for thirty-one years, and he could tell you where the water was in a dry August and where it was not in a wet one. He said the top is not the point, and he said it so often that my father stopped asking him why he went.

In 1987 he went up with two men half his age, and one of them said afterwards that my uncle had ⑦ come out on top because he had known when to stop, which is not a thing you usually win by. The ⑧ top of the cairn had been knocked off by lightning in 1974, and he rebuilt it with his own hands on the way down, which nobody had asked him to do.

He died in 1998, at sixty-one, in his bed. The ⑨ top, meaning the summit he reached once in eleven attempts, is the only thing anybody remembers about him, and he would have hated that. The ⑩ top of the tin, when we opened it in 2011, was rusted shut, and there were eleven things inside, and one of them was a button from a shirt.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 顶部；上面；上端
D. adj. 顶级的；最上面的；最好的
E. 固定搭配：at the top of ... 在……的顶端／顶部
F. 固定搭配：on top of ... 除……之外（还）；在……之上
G. 固定搭配：from top to bottom 从上到下；彻底
H. 固定搭配：come out on top 最终获胜；名列前茅

items.q: at the top of it there is a cairn
He was never a top climber
His top was always too thin for the height
On top of all that, he knew the mountain
he knew the mountain from top to bottom
my uncle had come out on top
The top of the cairn had been knocked off
The top, meaning the summit he reached once
The top of the tin, when we opened it

answers.why: the top 意为“山顶、顶峰”，叔叔爬了同一座山十一次，只登顶过一次。
at the top of it 意为“在它的顶端”，山顶上有一座石堆，里面放着一只铁盒。
top 作形容词，意为“顶级的、最好的”，他从来不是顶级的攀登者——他慢，而且害怕。
his top 意为“他的上衣、上装”，他的上衣对这个高度来说总是太单薄。
on top of all that 意为“除此之外（还）”，除此之外，他还熟悉这座山。
from top to bottom 意为“从上到下、彻底”，他把这座山从头到尾都摸透了。
come out on top 意为“最终胜出、占了上风”，同行的年轻人说我叔叔最终胜出，因为他知道何时停下。
the top of the cairn 意为“石堆的顶部”，石堆的顶部 1974 年被雷劈掉了。
the top 意为“山顶、顶峰”，指他十一次尝试中登顶的那一次。
the top of the tin 意为“铁盒的盖子、顶端”，2011 年我们打开时，铁盒的盖子锈死了。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 我叔叔爬了同一座山十一次，只登顶过一次。（top）
山顶上有一座石堆，里面放着一只铁盒。（at the top of）
他从来不是顶级的攀登者：他慢，而且害怕。（top）
除此之外，他还把这座山从头到尾都摸透了。（on top of / from top to bottom）
同行的年轻人说，我叔叔最终胜出，因为他知道何时停下。（come out on top）
石堆的顶部在 1974 年被雷劈掉了，他下山时亲手把它重砌了起来。（the top of）
answers: My uncle climbed the same mountain eleven times and reached the top once.
At the top of it there is a cairn with a tin inside.
He was never a top climber: he was slow and frightened.
On top of all that, he knew the mountain from top to bottom.
One of the men said afterwards that my uncle had come out on top because he had known when to stop.
The top of the cairn had been knocked off by lightning in 1974, and he rebuilt it on the way down.
